before.content:
& "$root\gradlew.bat" :ji-host-web:stage5TopologyFixtureDist --offline --no-daemon
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Stage 5 Remote Host fixture distribution build failed" }
    $fixtureDist = Join-Path $root "ji-java/applications/ji-host-web/build/stage5-topology-fixture"
    & tar -czf $archive -C $fixtureDist .
    $runId = [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N")
    $remoteRoot = "`$HOME/ji-stage5-remote-$runId"
    & ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -i $IdentityFile $Target "mkdir -p $remoteRoot/fixture"

after.content:
& "$root\gradlew.bat" :ji-host-web:stage5TopologyFixtureDist --offline --no-daemon
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Stage 5 Remote Host fixture distribution build failed" }
    $fixtureDist = Join-Path $root "ji-java/applications/ji-host-web/build/stage5-topology-fixture"
    $tar = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot "System32\tar.exe"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tar -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Windows system tar is unavailable" }
    & $tar -czf $archive -C $fixtureDist .
    $runId = [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N")
    $remoteRoot = "`$HOME/ji-stage5-remote-$runId"
    & ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -i $IdentityFile $Target "mkdir -p $remoteRoot/fixture"
